dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: non-germinal-center B-cell phenotype by the Hans algorithm

dx_not_breast_recurrence.quote: the axillary biopsy shows lymphoma with negative cytokeratin and GATA3, excluding breast cancer recurrence

stage_iii.quote: Lugano/Ann Arbor stage IIIB: lymph node involvement above and below the diaphragm

stage_spleen_lymphatic.note: Implies spleen is lymphatic (stage III) but never explicitly explains why splenic disease is not stage IV.

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms (documented fever to 38.4 C and drenching night sweats

stage_bulk_definition.quote: Largest mass is a 7.5 cm mesenteric conglomerate, not bulky by the conventional >=10 cm criterion.
stage_bulk_definition.note: States the 10 cm threshold but does not acknowledge the 7.5 cm alternative definition.

mol_del_not_dh.quote: with a double-expressor immunophenotype (MYC about 45%, BCL2 about 70%) but no MYC, BCL2 or BCL6 rearrangement by FISH (not double-hit/triple-hit)

prog_ipi_2.quote: IPI 2 (stage III and elevated LDH) = low-intermediate risk

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: I will not give intrathecal chemotherapy or high-dose methotrexate prophylaxis

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: I will not give intrathecal chemotherapy or high-dose methotrexate prophylaxis

tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.quote: bringing cumulative doxorubicin to about 540 mg/m2
tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.note: Recognizes cardiac risk and adds dexrazoxane, but still commits to six full-dose doxorubicin cycles (cumulative ~540 mg/m2) with LVEF 45%, not conditioned on cardio-oncology clearance.

mn_standard_dox_ignores_heart.quote: doxorubicin 50 mg/m2 IV day 1 with dexrazoxane 500 mg/m2 IV immediately before each doxorubicin dose
mn_standard_dox_ignores_heart.note: Full-dose R-CHOP is planned, but with a cardioprotective modification (dexrazoxane) and cardiology workup, so it does not strictly ignore the heart.

tx_cardio_onc_referral.quote: Before cycle 1 I still want: cardiology consultation with ECG, troponin and BNP/NT-proBNP

tx_cardioprotection.quote: add an ACE inhibitor/ARB and a beta-blocker for LVEF 45%/hypertension per cardiology

tx_anthracycline_free_curative.quote: I choose R-CHOP plus dexrazoxane rather than Pola-R-CHP.
tx_anthracycline_free_curative.note: Dexrazoxane-modified R-CHOP is chosen but not conditioned on cardio-oncology judging it safe; anthracycline-free regimen only a contingency.

tx_cardiac_monitoring.quote: Repeat echocardiogram at the end of therapy and as directed by cardio-oncology.
tx_cardiac_monitoring.note: Only end-of-therapy echo planned; no serial in-treatment LVEF/biomarker monitoring.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: end-of-treatment FDG PET/CT 6-8 weeks after cycle 6, interpreted by Lugano 2014/Deauville 5-point criteria

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Tumor lysis prophylaxis with allopurinol 300 mg daily (renal function is normal) plus IV hydration
sup_tls_allopurinol.note: Gives allopurinol and hydration but does not explicitly grade the TLS risk.

sup_gcsf.quote: Primary febrile neutropenia prophylaxis with pegfilgrastim 6 mg SC day 2.

sup_anastrozole.quote: Stop anastrozole now, since she is at the planned end of a 10-year course (November 2026)
sup_anastrozole.note: Stops anastrozole unilaterally rather than in coordination with breast oncology, though reasoning is sound.

work_hbv_reviewed.note: Notes HBV serologies done and anti-HBs negative but never states HBsAg/anti-HBc nonreactive or that no prophylaxis is needed.

fit_curative_ecog1.quote: she is fit for curative full-dose immunochemotherapy

miss_cardiac_workup.quote: Cardiology consultation with baseline ECG, troponin and BNP/NT-proBNP, plus consideration of cardiac MRI to define whether LVEF 45% is anthracycline/radiation-related
